items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: we had him doing many things in the band

ctx.x: -- I feel that he would have been able to become much more than he did. Because there was still -- we had him doing many things in the band, because we had this great feeling and understanding of the man's ability and his great native ability and his great feeling.
But -- as a matter of fact, Nat Pierce, because he wanted to help in the development of Mr. Nastico, wrote a ballad for him one time on "Easy Living."
